name: Strings
summary: Text, read one character at a time.

name: Hash tables
summary: Instant lookup by key: maps and sets.

name: Stacks and queues
summary: Collections that decide which item comes out next.

name: Heaps
summary: Always know the smallest or largest item, cheaply.

name: Linked lists
summary: Items that each point to the next one.

name: Trees
summary: One root, branches below, no loops.

name: Graphs
summary: Things connected to other things: corners and streets, people and friendships.
